color.description: Optional hex color displayed alongside the role (e.g. '#ff8800').

hoisted.description: Whether members of this role are displayed separately in the member list.

position.description: Hierarchy position. Higher values sit higher in the role hierarchy and outrank lower values.

protected.description: Whether this role is protected from modification or deletion. Set true for system-managed roles (e.g. the bootstrap 'Owner' role minted by `community.create`).

mentionable.description: Whether `@role`-style mentions resolve to this role.

items.description: A namespaced permission identifier. See AppView permission catalog.

permissions.description: Permission identifiers granted by this role.

channelOverrides.description: Per-channel permission overrides for this role.

main.description: A named bundle of permissions assignable to community members. Lives on the community repo.

deny.description: Permissions denied within this channel. Deny wins over base permissions and overrides allow.

channel.description: The channel this override applies to.

channelOverride.description: Allow / deny lists scoped to a single channel.
